question: Should Control UI add a per-message Markdown/plain-text copy menu, and what plain-text representation should it guarantee for structured Markdown?
rationale: The capability is still missing, but choosing between a local menu and persisted preference—and defining how structured content is flattened—is a user-facing product contract rather than a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Add a local copy menu
options.body: Keep Markdown as the existing action and add plain text in a compact per-message menu with documented conversion rules.

options.title: Add a persisted preference
options.body: Let users choose a default format, accepting additional settings and upgrade surface for a small clipboard feature.

options.title: Retain Markdown only
options.body: Decline the additional interaction and keep the current single-purpose copy control.

recommendation.title: Add a local copy menu
recommendation.body: Keep Markdown as the existing action and add plain text in a compact per-message menu with documented conversion rules.

likelyOwner.reason: The behavior originates in their Control UI copy implementation and they remain the strongest history-backed routing candidate for the UX decision.
